name: website
title: Website
summary: Pages that load fast, read well on a phone and never break a link.

rules.text: Every page reads in full with JavaScript turned off.
rules.why: search engines, slow phones and screen readers often meet a page before its scripts run.

rules.text: No change leaves a link pointing at a missing page.
rules.why: a broken link is a dead end for every reader who follows it.

items.title: Every internal link points at a real page
items.criterion: Every link from one page of the site to another points at a page that exists in the built site. test/links.test.js builds the site, follows every internal link, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- test/links.test.js
Test:
- test/links.test.js builds the site locally, follows every internal link, and fails on a link to a missing page

items.title: Every page reads in full with JavaScript turned off
items.criterion: The main text of every page is in the HTML the site serves, before any script runs. test/no-javascript.test.js reads every built page without running its scripts and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- test/no-javascript.test.js
Test:
- test/no-javascript.test.js reads each built page as plain HTML and fails when its main text is missing
